content.value: What is meant by all day efficiency of a transformer? A 100 kVA transformer has a full load (12) loss of 3 kW, the losses being equally divided between iron and copper. During a day, the transformer operates on full load for 3 hours, one half load for 4 hours, 75% of full load for 4 hours, the output being negligible for rest of the day. Calculate the all-day efficiency. (Assume, p.f.=1)

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
